name: Fukui Masanobu
source:
A rival.
An unpopular otaku in Akito's class. Runs a website containing voyeuristic pictures and videos of his female classmates, and has hidden video cameras set up all over the school to collect new footage. Obsesses over Aoi as the school's idol.
